criteria.text: PRD disk files updated during VERIFY phase with evidence
criteria.description: FINDING: 59/60 PRDs stuck at DRAFT. Root cause: PRD update is prompt-instructed, not enforced by code. Model skips PRD disk writes. No hook validates or forces PRD sync.

criteria.text: ISC.json on disk populated with criteria from TaskCreate
criteria.description: FINDING: 59/59 ISC.json have 0 criteria. Same root cause as C1: AutoWorkCreation creates empty scaffold, but model never writes criteria back. TaskCreate goes to working memory only, never synced to disk ISC.json.

criteria.text: All identified gaps documented with root cause analysis
criteria.description: FINDING: 6 gaps documented with root causes. See VERIFY output for full analysis.

criteria.text: Learning capture files created for significant completed sessions
criteria.description: FINDING: 54 completed sessions, only 3 learning files (all from Feb 22 testing). Gate bug + inference speed already fixed this session. Future sessions should work. No backfill needed — historical sessions have low value since PRDs were empty.

criteria.text: THREAD.md files contain actual phase progression log data
criteria.description: FINDING: All 59 THREAD.md files have only template content. Phase sections all show "_Pending..._". Same root cause: model instructed to update but doesn't. No enforcement mechanism.

criteria.text: Loop mode CLI functional and tested with real PRD
criteria.description: FINDING: algorithm.ts CLI works (help, status commands functional). Supports loop/interactive modes, parallel agents 1-16. BUT: useless in practice because PRDs have 0 criteria — loop has nothing to iterate on. Chicken-and-egg: model must write ISC to PRD first.
